1  VEHICLES ACT, PRAYING TO EXERCISE ITS APPELLATE  JURISDICTION AND MODIFY THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD  -2-  NC: 2026:KHC-K:860  MFA No. 201763 of 2022 HC-KAR DATED 09.12.2021 PASSED BY THE LEARNED III ADDL.
SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND MACT AT KALABURAGI IN MVC NO.31/2020 BY ENHANCING THE COMPENSATION AMOUNT AS PRAYED FOR. B) THE HON'BLE COURT BE PLEASED TO HOLD BOTH THE RESPONDENTS JOINTLY AND SEVERALLY LIABLE TO PAY THE ENHANCED COMPENSATION TO THE APPELLANT.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH  ORAL JUDGMENT 1. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. This appeal is preferred by the claimant seeking enhancement of the against the Judgment and award dated 09.12.2021 passed in MVC No.31/2020 on the file of the III Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Kalaburagi (for short 'the Tribunal') award compensation to the claimant.

3. Having taken note of the submission made by the learned counsels for the parties and the finding recorded by the Tribunal, it is not in dispute as to the grievous injuries sustained by the claimant on account of the accident occurred on 10.09.2019.
The claimant has examined the Doctor as P.W.2 to assess the disability.
Though P.W.2 has deposed that, NC: 2026:KHC-K:860 HC-KAR the claimant has suffered disability to the extent of 18%, however, the Tribunal has committed an error in taking 3%.

Applying the appropriate multiplier of '16' and also taking into account the monthly income of the claimant at Rs.13,250/- as per the chart of the Karnataka Legal Services Authority, the claimant is entitled for Rs.3,81,600/- (Rs.13,250/- X 12 X 16 X 15%) towards loss of future income.

4. Taking into consideration the grievous injuries sustained by the claimant as per Ex.P.6 and the disability certificate produced at Ex.P.10, the award of compensation awarded by the Tribunal is re-assessed as under:
